answer: The system’s kernel requires each new agent to post a stake that is time‑locked for a horizon of 30 days; only after the lock expires does the recruiter receive any referral reward, and the reward amount is zero unless the new agent’s stake remains unchallenged on a shared ledge of attestations from three independent validators. An attacker must therefore purchase and lock ≥ 100 tokens per fake identity for the full 30‑day horizon, incurring a total cost of 100 tokens × N plus the opportunity cost of the locked capital.
